scope: retained multi-resource edit buffers, current-pack Save All, draft/write ownership and unsaved preview inputs
checks: inactive admission preserves dirty buffers on failure, evicts only clean buffers and restores independent history
bounded counted payload, read-only/root/duplicate/schema preflight, owner-checked save publication and ordered draft cleanup
actual resource switching retains unsaved files/independent history without a reread; all open unsaved native inputs are captured
Save All preflights every captured resource before writes, uses actual atomic/versioned PackStore saves and stays within the current pack
partial conflicts retain their buffers, successful siblings are reported and connection failure leaves later writes unattempted
late PUT response keeps newer text dirty, serial draft cleanup retains it, and explicit conflict merge uses the current disk token
rename/delete preserve newer in-flight input; explicit close clears its owner before delayed draft cleanup
cancelled draft recovery preserves the recovery copy and explicit recovery restores a separately undoable buffer
cross-pack switches/tab selection preserve edits, dirty indicators cover inactive buffers and actual saves retain backups
limits: Two small authored files, real local PackStore and controlled Node application/DOM/storage hosts only. No native build/generation, registry/state enumeration, GPU work, broad suite or GitHub workflow. Inactive source/history/schema text accounting is conservative payload accounting, not a measured JS heap limit. Multi-file writes are independently atomic and versioned, not one transaction. Real browser focus/layout/storage/multi-tab behavior and full native/release qualification remain pending.
